full_suite.step: Run every repository test with inclusive package coverage

institutional_relationships.verified: C2FO Instant Pay financing and settlement activity is intended to use XRPL, with RLUSD as the settlement asset. Participating capital providers fund early payment; suppliers receive funds in seconds in the proposed workflow.
institutional_relationships.rollout: C2FO product page shows a waitlist and limited U.S. rollout over coming months.
institutional_relationships.actual_capital: Capital-provider identities, commitments, funded balances and XRPL transaction volumes are not disclosed.
exclusions: RLUSD settlement on XRPL is not evidence that XRP is the bridge asset.
C2FO's more than $525B historical Early Pay working-capital figure is platform-wide historical activity, not Instant Pay volume, not XRP capital and not Ripple funding.

institutional_relationships.verified: RLUSD trading/management is live in supported regions on Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase retail; deposits/withdrawals are supported on XRPL, Base and Ethereum; USD-to-RLUSD conversion is 1:1.
institutional_relationships.future: Coinbase Global Exchange customer availability and use of RLUSD as collateral were explicitly future scope at launch.
institutional_relationships.xrp_classification: Stablecoin distribution and XRPL rail support; no XRP purchase or bridge-volume disclosure.

institutional_relationships.verified: RLUSD is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp by Robinhood; Robinhood app availability was expected later. Robinhood plans RLUSD use on XRPL for institutional settlement and integration of Ripple Treasury.
institutional_relationships.other_scope: Ripple Prime already has a financing/liquidity relationship with Bitstamp; future perpetual-futures support was announced.
institutional_relationships.xrp_classification: Institutional settlement and stablecoin distribution; no XRP bridge or proprietary XRP purchase quantified.

institutional_relationships.verified: BNY Digital Asset Custody now supports XRP and RLUSD; BNY remains primary RLUSD reserve custodian and has a custody relationship with Ripple Prime.
institutional_relationships.future: Direct RLUSD mint/redeem, broader XRPL tokenized assets and a C2FO supply-chain-finance initiative are intended/exploratory and subject to approvals/client requirements.
institutional_relationships.xrp_classification: Actual XRP custody support is confirmed; custody balances and proprietary purchases are not disclosed.

institutional_relationships.verified: Limited corporate/institutional pilot allows eligible PNC clients to receive Circle USDC, automatically converted into USD, with Coinbase supplying the infrastructure.
institutional_relationships.xrp_classification: Competing USDC payment rail; not an XRP corridor.

ripple_company_reported_metrics.classification: Company-reported; not audited here. Annualized run rate is not realized revenue/cash capital; $16T covers all Ripple products, not XRP volume; $150B is Ripple Payments lifetime volume, not XRP on-ledger volume; RLUSD market cap is not XRP market cap.

actual_capital_reconciliation.c2fo_participating_capital_providers: Unnamed; no amount or commitment disclosed.
actual_capital_reconciliation.c2fo_early_pay_525b: Historical platform-wide early-payment working capital; not Instant Pay, XRP, Ripple financing or newly committed capital.
actual_capital_reconciliation.ripple_900m_run_rate: Company-reported annualized product revenue; not cash raised or XRP purchases.
actual_capital_reconciliation.ripple_16t_2025: Transactions enabled across Ripple products; not XRP settlement volume.
actual_capital_reconciliation.ripple_150b_lifetime: Ripple Payments lifetime volume; not XRP volume.

competing_hypotheses_and_disconfirming_e: Institutional use of XRPL can increase ledger utility without requiring XRP to serve as the bridge asset; C2FO's announced settlement asset is RLUSD.
C2FO Instant Pay is on a waitlist/limited rollout; announced architecture is not demonstrated throughput.
Coinbase RLUSD distribution is live, but Coinbase Global Exchange collateral use was future scope at launch.
Robinhood app distribution was expected later; the announced institutional XRPL settlement use does not quantify XRP purchases.
BNY supports XRP custody, but custody capability is not evidence of BNY proprietary holdings or client balance scale.
PNC/Coinbase/Circle USDC is a competing dollar rail and may reduce the assumption that institutional stablecoin settlement necessarily routes through Ripple.
